records.prompt: Create ONE high-quality hand-drawn 2D action-game pose development sheet of this SAME adult white-haired swordsman. Reference 1 defines identity and adult body proportions, reference 2 defines current approved-direction mature anatomy/rendering/clothing, reference 3 defines the independent katana design. Native requested production canvas 2560x1440 transparent. Exactly TWO full figures side by side, no overlap, both facing screen-right, SAME physical body scale, same adult head size and same limb lengths. LEFT FIGURE: neutral straight standing upright calibration companion, feet on a shared ground line. RIGHT FIGURE: third normal attack initial LOW CROUCHED LOAD before a forceful rising slash. Broad staggered planted feet, front right knee bent deeply, back left leg braced; pelvis low, body weight coiled low and slightly back. Chest leans slightly forward from hips, head follows chest naturally (not fixed in space), eyes looking forward. BOTH HANDS visibly wrap the SAME sword handle close together in front of the pelvis, right primary nearest guard and left secondary behind, anatomically natural wrists, no crossed wrists. Katana blade extends screen-right almost horizontally with a slight downward tilt, its tip CLEARLY ABOVE GROUND. Crucially turn the blade so the sharp white cutting edge faces UPWARD, spine below, preparing to cut from low to high. No sword on hip/back, no scabbard. The black coat with crimson lining trails behind, not hiding thigh/knee anatomy. Keep restrained body detail and adult long legs, compact head, realistic action silhouette, same black clothes/red forearm wraps/steel kneecaps and dark boots. No chibi, no oversized head, no blur, no effects or trails, no lettering, no floor/shadow, no extra figures. Leave generous clear space around each silhouette, whole boots and blade visible. These are source key poses, not an animation strip.
